thought.text: Ports are free. Now I'll launch `docker compose up -d` in the background (this builds the server image, which takes a while).

reasoning_content:
Ports are available, 7.6GB RAM, 8 cores. Alright, let's kick off the build in the background. `make dev` = `docker compose up` (foreground). Instead, I'll run it as a detached build:

`docker compose build` (foreground, can be time-consuming) — actually, let's run `docker compose up -d` in the background with logging. This will build the server image, start all services, and wait.

The build will fetch node:20-alpine, elixir:1.20-alpine, alpine:3.23, npm packages, and mix deps. Let's get started. I'll write logs to /tmp/nebu_build.log.

action.command: cd /workspace && nohup docker compose up -d > /tmp/nebu_up.log 2>&1 & echo "started pid $!"
